visual_appeal: Hero card: the right column under '1.5 / LEVELS BANKED' is dead space (~180x90 px). Move the instruction line into the hero's bottom-right, or put a one-line 'Wasting rest for 1d 16h' sub-stat in cream #E8DCC0 at 12 px under the unit.

The NOW PLAYING strip shows a 240 px empty black track next to '0.0 rested levels left'. When rested is 0, hide the track. Replace it with one line in muted grey #9A8F7E: 'No rested XP: every kill at 1x'. Give the freed width to the NOT RESTING chip and a 'Hearth' hint.
Resting bars at 9-21% are mostly black. Lift the empty track from near-black to #1E1912 with a 1 px #3A3024 inner line so rows read as filled cards, not holes.
Night shading in the timeline (saturated slate #2E3A5A blocks) is the loudest thing in the window. Drop it to #1C2230 at 60% alpha so state colours stay dominant.
play_next_clarity: 'Fully rested. Full for 1d 16h.' is ambiguous: it reads like a countdown. Say 'Full since 1d 16h ago: rest is going to waste' in green #5FD35F, with 'going to waste' in yellow #FFD24A.

Make the instruction line the strongest text after the name. Raise it to 14 px, cream #F2E2B0. Put a hearthstone icon (16 px) before 'take Le Jette to an inn'. Highlight 'Le Dette' as a class-coloured link that opens the card.

Row numbering starts at 2 under a hero labelled '#1 · PLAY NEXT', which is fine. But the hero's left accent is green only in the default theme. Add the same 4 px state-colour accent to the ElvUI hero so #1 visually belongs to the ranked list.
state_colours: Jacques Hammer's name is shaman blue #0070DE on the red-tinted row (#3A1A16). That is roughly 2.3:1 contrast. Brighten the row tint less (#2A1612) or give class-coloured names a 1 px black shadow at 90% alpha in every row.

The NEARLY FULL chip (olive fill, yellow text) is the only chip with a tinted fill besides NOT RESTING, so it reads louder than RESTING but muddier than red. Make NEARLY FULL a quiet chip like RESTING (dark fill #2A2214, 1 px #E6C229 border, #F0D040 text).
Legend dots are 8 px. Make them 10 px with a 1 px dark ring so yellow #E6C229 and orange #E08A1E are distinguishable at a glance on the dark band.
character_identity: Defect: Le Beouf has a saved look (the card in scene 06 shows the tauren face), but roster row 7 still shows the class icon. The settled rule says a saved look shows the face with a small class badge. Use it in the roster, the hero, the timeline lane and the toasts too.

Race/gender badges have regressed. In the baseline they were readable coloured faces (pink-haired gnome). Now every row has the same grey 14 px blob. Use the coloured race icon at 18 px with a 1 px #C8A85A ring, offset -2/-2 from the bottom-right of the 40 px portrait.
Le Nette and Amdo Rhen show identical fire-mage icons. When two rows share a class icon, the race badge is the only differentiator, which is another reason the badge must be legible.

NOW PLAYING shows a class sword instead of the live face (the baseline had the face). If this is a simulator limitation, fine. Make sure SetPortraitTexture('player') is used in game and the class badge sits bottom-right.
default_theme: The red 'X' close button is a flat red square with a plain glyph and looks placeholder. Use UIPanelCloseButton art, or a 20x20 bronze-rimmed button with #E04A3A X.
The parchment-brown row fill (#4A3A26) flattens contrast for the light class colours. Darken alternating rows to #2C2318 / #33291C.
The green '1.5' in the default theme versus cream in ElvUI is inconsistent. Pick cream #F2E2B0 for both, and let the state accent carry the green.
The hero background art is nice. Add a 40% black gradient from the left so the name and meta line never sit on bright tavern detail.
elvui_wc3_fit: The frame border has a visible seam/step where the hero block meets the roster (around y=405, with bolts and a notch on both sides). It looks like two frames stacked. Use one continuous backdrop, or align both sections to the same outer inset.

The footer mixes three button styles: blue 'Unlink', blue 'All accounts', and gold 'View details'/'Done'. ElvUI reference buttons are blue, and the single red is reserved. Keep gold for the one primary action per screen and blue for everything else. The account selector needs a dropdown chevron.

The options page (07) is light taupe #4A4238. The real ElvUI options (ref 3) are near-black brown #16110C panels with yellow #FFD100 labels. Match the reference backdrop and use its dark inset content panel and section bars.
Options search box: grey with no magnifier icon and no placeholder. Match the reference 'Search' field with the icon and a #C8A85A border.
alerts_ux: Move-mode placeholders use a beige radial glow behind white text ('When you log out outside a rest area.'), which is low contrast. Use the real alert surface or a dark #1A140E fill. Mark placeholders with a dashed 1 px #FFD100 outline and a 'DRAG' grip icon.
Per-item 'Reset' is only visible on the Toasts placeholder. Show it on every placeholder (top-right, 52x18) or on hover for all, consistently.
Move mode blacks the screen out almost completely. Dim to 55% black so the user can place items relative to their real UI. Add faint 1/3 grid and centre guides with snapping within 8 px.
Stray unlabelled artifacts in move mode (a horizontal bar at ~375,573 and a grey square at ~749,585) must be hidden or labelled.

The second banner variant (grey flat surface) and the wooden logout banner look like different addons. Use one surface for all alerts. The wood plank texture behind 12 px text is busy, so put a 70% dark overlay on the text area.

The logout banner breaks its copy mid-thought ('Hearth to Feathermoon Stronghold / or find an inn, then log out.') and leaves an empty line. Use one line: 'Hearth to Feathermoon Stronghold or find an inn, then log out.'
readability: The footer text 'Paired with Le Bankken, synced 3h ago' wraps to two lines. Shorten it to 'Linked: Le Bankken · synced 3h ago' on one line, or move it into a tooltip on the Unlink button.
'None used yet' in NOW PLAYING has no subject. Restore the briefed copy: '~1 double-XP kill · none used yet', or better 'No rested XP banked'.
The 'Acct #3' tag is blue 10 px next to a white name and easy to miss. Use a bordered pill: 1 px #5A7FBF, text #A8C4F0 at 11 px, 4 px padding.
Options: the About block is a solid wall of yellow body text. Use a bold 'About' header, set the body in #CFC6B4, and add 12 px spacing above it.
Timeline: 'Full Wed 2 Dec' repeated three times at the bar end sits on top of the fade. Put the date in a fixed right gutter column (70 px), outside the plot.
layout_polish: Options radio row: 'ElvUI' sits ~200 px away from 'Default' while the other gaps are ~120 px. Use equal 24 px gaps.
The slider shows no visible thumb, only a tiny fill. Add a 10x16 thumb and the current value ('10%') next to it.
The Close button overlaps a blue strip artifact at its top-right. Fix the z-order and inset.

Card (06): the bar and status sentence sit outside the hero box with a short orange stub and a two-line wrap. Put the bar inside the box under 'Level 11 Tauren Druid', full width, with the status on one line: 'Resting · 0.1 lvl banked · Full Thu 3 Dec, 05:00'.

Card (06): 'Last seen as a level 11 Tauren Druid.' duplicates the meta line. Remove it. 'Hearth' and 'Logged out in' both say Thunder Bluff, so merge them as 'Hearth / logged out: Thunder Bluff' when they are equal. Trim the ~110 px of empty space at the bottom.
Compact tooltip (08): there is a stray brown rectangle behind the 'Rested Leveling / best to play first' header. Remove it or make it a full-width header bar.

Timeline: 5 of 7 lanes are identical full-width orange bars, so 48 h tells little for 8-9 day fills. Add a compressed '48h-10d' tail segment (last 15% of width, labelled) so the bars end at their real day.
delight: The speech lines are good. Let the hero bubble rotate on open, and tie a line to the state for NOT RESTING rows ('It is cold out here.').
Add a subtle 300 ms shimmer on full bars when rest is being wasted (respect Reduce motion).
Toast: when an alt fills, show the alt's face plus a short 'Ding! Le Dette is full' sound option (off by default).

overall_notes: A real step up from 1.1.2. The single red (gold action button), quieter chips, unit-labelled hero figure, word-shortening instead of ellipses, the Acct pill and the dot legend all fix baseline complaints. The play-next story is clear. It is held back by craft details a demanding user will notice. There is a frame seam between the hero and the roster. The footer wraps and mixes button colours. Race badges have regressed into unreadable grey blobs. The saved look is not used in the roster row. The NOW PLAYING empty bar and 'None used yet' copy are weak. The ElvUI options page does not match the dark reference. The move-mode placeholders have low contrast and inconsistent per-item Reset. The timeline is mostly a wall of identical orange bars. Fix the identity rule and the seams first, then copy and spacing. That puts it in the 8s; 9 needs the timeline and alerts surface unified.
